shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a yellow shirt sits at the sideboard-side aisle seat and asks whether city life is better than country life. A woman in a red shirt sits at the sideboard-side window seat. A man in a green shirt sits at the patio-side window seat. There is one empty place.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the patio doors end, looking along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the sideboard in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a purple shirt enters and sits in the empty place. A man in a yellow shirt asks about personal preferences, and she defends country living.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent aisle-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a yellow shirt explains the advantages of city life.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the window side, centered on the person at the sideboard-side aisle seat.

shots.content: A man in a yellow shirt asks about rural customs, and a man in a green shirt replies.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the dining table.
